505702.caption: Please stay by my side, Commander. I will keep you safe and stop anything that might try to harm you... No matter what it might be.

505703.caption: My outfit? ...It isn't particularly heavy for a Doll. It is essential gear, and I am a warrior.

505704.caption: Working with AN-94 is relaxing. She is a competent leader and she has excellent combat skills, so she works well with me... and also, she puts me at ease.

505705.caption: I'm not bothered by how my commander uses me. When I question my orders, it is usually because I cannot see how they lead to the completion of the objective... However, nothing good ever comes of questioning them. You, on the other hand, have never given me cause to question you. That is ample proof of your superiority.
